theme: Planning Data coordinate API and DPD taxonomy
facts: Planning Data API exposes over 100 planning and housing datasets through one interface.
Coordinate queries use latitude and longitude.
Coordinate queries return entities whose geometry intersects the supplied point for selected datasets.
Multiple dataset parameters may be supplied.
A limit parameter controls returned entity count.
API documentation provides entity.json coordinate-query examples.
Development-plan-document is a document dataset, not necessarily a geometry dataset.
Development plan documents can carry document-types including site-allocations.
Document taxonomy is not parcel geometry.
A site-allocations document type does not prove a candidate lies inside an allocation polygon.
Planning Data entity pages expose source quality where present.
Geometry-bearing entity datasets can expose WKT/GeoJSON geometry.
Exact negative requires a complete relevant geometry set or actual no-hit response from the intended dataset.
Query transport failure is not an empty response.
Planning Data evidence can corroborate authority/temporal/document context while borough target polygons remain the preferred binding evidence.
